data.long_meaning: Adala is derived from the Arabic word 'adl, which means justice, fairness, and righteousness. In Islamic context, it signifies being just and fair in actions and intentions. It is a beautiful name for a girl, instilling a sense of virtue and morality. The name Adala carries the meaning “Justice, Fairness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Adala usually hope their child will grow to embody justice, fairness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
